verified_contracts: Production HTTP submits the Worker plan and its authorized peer links. Out-of-scope requests and cycles across dependencies and blocking requests are rejected.
An identical request or reply is deduplicated, conflicting requests fail, and each request or reply gets one durable delivery acknowledgement.
An early reply stays in the mailbox until the sender's previous turn finishes. Delivery starts another Run in the original private Session and workspace.
Restart before acknowledgement preserves the request. Restart after acknowledgement preserves the exact queued Run and does not append a duplicate input.

An expired request delivers a timeout to the waiting sender, and the expired request does not start another recipient attempt. A prior verified wait keeps dependencies queued until the subsequent Worker turn finishes.
Fresh and V53 to V58 fixture copies pass integrity and foreign key checks. The V58 selected main conversation and root authority snapshot survive the upgrade.
